# Paragraph 2. Amendment of Third Schedule

2. The Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 is amended by substituting for the Third Schedule the following schedule:

“THIRD SCHEDULE [Sections 43 and 44A]

RATE OF MONTHLY CONTRIBUTIONS

PART A

1. The rate of monthly contributions specified in this Part shall apply to the following employees until the employees attain the age of sixty years:

(a) employees who are Malaysian citizens;

(b) employees who are not Malaysian citizens but are permanent residents in Malaysia; and

(c) employees who are not Malaysian citizens who have elected to contribute before 1 August 1998. 63
